title: More than 100,000 sign petition for inquiry into UK role in Gaza genocide
detail: Per Al Jazeera (Nov 9, 2026), more than 100,000 people have signed a petition calling for an inquiry into the United Kingdom's role in the Gaza war, which the petition describes as genocide. Single-outlet report based on the headline and summary; petition wording and the government's response were not verified.

media.caption: Petition calls for inquiry into UK role in Gaza war
